The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one jaeger brigade, one unmanned systems brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, three national guard brigades, and the Azov special forces brigade near Lidino, Belozerskoye, Malotaranovka, Kalinino, Verovka, Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), and Novopavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU's losses amounted to more than 430 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 11 motor vehicles, five field artillery guns, including one U.S.-made 155-mm Paladin self-propelled artillery system, and four electronic warfare stations.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two assault brigades, three air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade close to Golubkovo, Zalivnoye, Obshcheye, Voskresenka (Zaporozhye region), Vasilkovka, Malinovka, and Velikomikhaylovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU lost more than 260 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 12 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
🔥
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of two mechanised brigades and one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine were hit near Orekhov, Preobrazhenka, and Kushugum (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 50 troops, 17 motor vehicles, one U.S.-made 155-mm M777 howitzer, and one electronic warfare station were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage on
Ukrainian logistics centres, power and transport infrastructure facilities used by the AFU, military airfields, ammunition depots, fuel and military materiel depots, assembly workshops and storage facilities of unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 153 areas.
▫️

item.title: 🚩 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 🚩 Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region tighten the encirclement and expand the external control zone. As a result of decisive actions, the settlements of Polnaya and Novoaleksandrovka (Kharkov region) have been brought under control. 💥 Inside the encirclement, strikes were delivered at enemy manpower and hardware close to Buzovo, Krasny Yar, Reznikovo, Varvarovka, and Khripuny (Kharkov region). ▪️ The AFU's blocked formations suffered losses of more than 35 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, one artillery gun, and one ground robotic system. ▫️ Active combat operations are conducted to expand the external control zone near Petropavlovka and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region). The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region tighten the encirclement
and expand the external control zone. As a result of decisive actions,
the settlements of Polnaya and Novoaleksandrovka (Kharkov region) have been brought under control.
💥
Inside the encirclement, strikes were delivered at
enemy manpower and hardware close to Buzovo, Krasny Yar, Reznikovo, Varvarovka, and Khripuny (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU's blocked formations suffered losses of more than 35 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, one artillery gun, and one ground robotic system.
▫️
Active combat operations are conducted to expand the external control zone
near Petropavlovka and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region).
Three attempts to deploy the AFU's reinforcement groups
from Velikiy Burluk to Olkhovatka (Kharkov region)
were thwarted.
📍
In addition,
in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at
manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades and assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine close to Sosnovka, Podsredneye and Sosnovy Bor.
🔥
In Sumy region,
formations of three mechanised brigades and one airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine
have been hit
close to Kiyanitsa, Vakalovshchina, Khoten, and Velikaya Chernetchina.
▪️
In total, the enemy has lost more than 265 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 24 motor vehicles, one MLRS, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, one assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade have been hit near Lozovoye, Volchiy Yar, Bogorodichnoye (Donetsk People's Republic), Lesnaya Stenka, Nizsheye Solenoye and Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 220 troops, 11 motor vehicles, four field artillery guns, including one U.S.-made 155-mm M777 howitzer, one MLRS, and one U.S.-made AN/TPQ-36 counter-fire radar.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Formations of four mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, one mountain assault brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade have been hit near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhkovka, Nikolayevka, Krasny Molochar, Vysokoivanovka, Vasilyevskaya Pustosh, and Chervonozaryanoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 215 troops, one tank, one armoured fighting vehicle, 19 motor vehicles, and eight field artillery guns.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation inflicted UAV strikes on logistics centres, depots and Ukrainian seaports, as well as vessels
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation inflicted UAV strikes on logistics centres, depots and Ukrainian seaports, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strikes, the following objects were engaged: 📍 in Kiev region: ▫️ in the settlement of Schastlivoye, the BDU Logistic centre in which depots storing and distributing of military materiel were organised; ▫️ in the settlement of Boyarka, a gas distribution station providing gas supply to the defence industry facilities; 📍 in Odessa region: ▫️ in the port of Odessa, a dry cargo ship , delivering cargo intended to support the AFU; ▫️ in the port of Izmail, port infrastructure facilities used to unload and store military cargo. ▫️ In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo intended to support the AFU to the port of Odessa was hit at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
